scenes.headline: The steam engine of our age is
scenes.narration: Steam powered the industrial age. Today a new engine is rising: artificial intelligence.
scenes.prompt: A 19th-century steam factory floor with giant pistons and smoke slowly dissolving into a bright modern data center with glowing server racks, continuous slow push-in.

scenes.label: From muscle to mind
scenes.narration: Factories once replaced human muscle. Now, machines are learning to assist the human mind.
scenes.prompt: Robotic arms working beside engineers in a clean, sunlit modern factory, warm light, slow tracking shot along the production line.

scenes.label: ChatGPT users within two months of launch
scenes.narration: ChatGPT reached one hundred million users in about two months.

scenes.label: Learning from patterns
scenes.narration: AI learns by spotting patterns in huge amounts of data, then uses them to make predictions.
scenes.prompt: Abstract glowing golden data streams flowing through a dark space and forming a network of light, slow camera fly-through.

scenes.title: How AI learns
scenes.caption: Patterns in, predictions out
scenes.narration: Think of it as a new kind of engine, one that runs on data instead of steam.
It is already helping doctors read scans, banks catch fraud, and couriers plan routes.
scenes.label: Already at work
scenes.prompt: A doctor in a bright hospital reviewing a medical scan on a large screen while highlighted areas appear, seen from over the shoulder, slow push-in.

scenes.line: The future is being built now.
scenes.narration: That is the future shift. Follow T&I News for more.
